product_features: three product indicators for every model; no date/symbol/target as input
target: next session open-to-close return in bps; sign may be momentum or reversal
embargo: fit entry_date strictly before earliest prediction signal date; entire date groups, not shuffled rows
preprocessing: StandardScaler inside each linear model pipeline, fitted only on that fold's fit rows; no scaling required for trees
threshold: product-specific absolute score 70th percentile on common 2021-2022 OOF cohort for all 14 signals; calibration is training-only, OOF portfolio metrics are mining diagnostics
selection: positive OOF mean rankIC and mean net, at least 100 trades, then highest OOF 5bps net Sharpe among 12 ML candidates; no selection using comparison-period metrics
comparison_status: already inspected in round 1; exploratory reused validation, not fresh independent confirmation
final_fit: all 2020-2022 available labels before first comparison signal date; frozen throughout 2023-2024
comparison_gate: positive rankIC and mean net, at least 50 trades; not final qualification
holdout: 2025 is not scored, fitted, or used to select models in this round
factor_differences: score rank correlations, active direction agreement with gap_raw, trading-position overlap, OOF feature-group permutation diagnostics, final-fit linear coefficients
stopping_rule: finish this single comparison round; no hyperparameter tuning after inspecting results, no auto-deployment
